title: Manage grant spending and reporting
summary: After accepting a grant, subsidy or reimbursable innovation award. Reconciled eligible spending, accepted reports and a controlled award closeout or remediation plan.
outcomes: Reconciled eligible spending, accepted reports and a controlled award closeout or remediation plan.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: After accepting a grant, subsidy or reimbursable innovation award.

parts.title: Translate the signed award into a control register
parts.guidance: Extract project dates, approved cost categories, matching funds, procurement rules, milestones and report requirements. Record sponsor approvals and amendments as the source of truth for the specific award.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve budget ownership and spending controls
parts.guidance: Finance and the project lead establish cost codes, time records, purchasing approval and evidence retention. Resolve restrictions with the sponsor before committing costs whose eligibility is uncertain.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve budget ownership and spending controls

parts.title: Reconcile project expenditure and progress
parts.guidance: Match payroll, invoices, procurement and project outputs to the award budget and supporting records. Keep ineligible, disputed and unspent amounts separate and investigate variances before preparing a claim.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Authorize reports, claims and change requests
parts.guidance: The responsible signatory reviews the narrative, cost claim and certifications before delivery. Request required scope or budget changes through the sponsor process instead of assuming an internal reallocation is permitted.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Authorize reports, claims and change requests

parts.title: Close the award and retain audit evidence
parts.guidance: Reconcile sponsor payments, adjustments, final reports and remaining obligations. Track unaccepted deliverables or possible repayments with an owner, and retain the evidence according to the award and applicable retention rules.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: Reconciled eligible spending, accepted reports and a controlled award closeout or remediation plan.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
